objective: Test whether task-set predictability survives a larger text-only task set and additional decoder families without treating benchmark labels as ground-truth cognitive constructs.
sampling_rule: Use 100 examples per task after verifying every pinned split and category has at least 100 usable examples. Freeze document IDs before the first model run.
decision_rule: Interpret a task-set effect as more robust only if its direction is stable under whole-task leave-out, task resampling, the within-family MMLU-Pro panel, and the cross-benchmark panel. Do not infer a knowledge-reasoning mechanism from either panel alone.

apertus-8b-instruct.runtime_condition: Engineering smokes used the Transformers Python xIELU fallback because the optional CUDA kernel was absent. Freeze this condition or validate numerical and output parity before changing it.

phi4-reasoning-plus-14b.exclusion_reason: The current concise tasks stop at a newline or short token ceiling, whereas this checkpoint emits a reasoning trace before its final answer. Correctness and output-length covariates would not be comparable.

gpt-oss-20b.exclusion_reason: The checkpoint uses a rendered reasoning channel and the current short direct-answer stop rules can truncate before the final answer; the optional MXFP4 execution backend is also not frozen.

matched_text_mmlu_pro_control.role: Within-family text control using one dataset, prompt, answer format, and generation path.
matched_text_mmlu_pro_control.claim_limit: MMLU-Pro categories mix factual knowledge and reasoning. These subject assignments are predeclared proxies, not pure constructs.

knowledge_tasks.rationale: Domain questions are expected to place comparatively high demand on acquired biological knowledge.
Domain questions are expected to place comparatively high demand on acquired health knowledge.
Historical questions are expected to place comparatively high demand on acquired factual knowledge.
Legal questions require specialized knowledge, with case reasoning retained as a known confound.
Economics requires domain knowledge and some calculation; the label is comparative only.

reasoning_tasks.rationale: Items often combine equations and multi-step physical inference; factual knowledge remains a confound.
Items often require algorithmic or formal inference; terminology knowledge remains a confound.
Items often require quantitative application of technical principles; domain knowledge remains a confound.
Items often require argument discrimination; historical and terminological knowledge remain confounds.

text_cross_benchmark_stress_test.role: Exploratory text-only test of whole-task transfer across independent benchmark families.
text_cross_benchmark_stress_test.claim_limit: Task family, domain, input length, number of choices, and answer type remain confounded. This panel tests robustness of task-set prediction, not a general knowledge-reasoning mechanism.

knowledge_tasks.rationale: Closed-book Natural Questions primarily tests information recoverable from model parameters.
The no-context protocol emphasizes closed-book factual retrieval.
Specialized medical knowledge is necessary, while clinical reasoning remains a known confound.
Broad graduate knowledge is necessary, while the source benchmark explicitly also measures reasoning.
Provides a knowledge-oriented MMLU-Pro anchor in the heterogeneous panel.

reasoning_tasks.rationale: GSM8K was constructed to test multi-step mathematical reasoning.
MuSR was constructed for multi-step reasoning over natural-language narratives.
ARC-Challenge requires science knowledge and reasoning and is therefore deliberately marked as a mixed proxy.
HellaSwag tests commonsense continuation inference, not formal multi-step reasoning.
Provides a reasoning-oriented MMLU-Pro anchor in the heterogeneous panel.
